primary_attributed_primitives_excluded: The adopted policy's copied/adapted primary exclusions.

related_concepts_reviewed.reason: Both mention caches, but deferred callable rendering and invalidation after statistical-data mutation use different state, invariants and source implementations.
Sequence-order reversal mutates segmented storage; inverse-map synchronization preserves a bijection during assignment. A shared word such as reverse does not make these the same source task.

These parse different input grammars and test different source behavior: unit-duration conversion, malformed-line error policy, and length-prefixed message admission. No shared parser implementation or same-task translation/paraphrase relation was found in the read source.

One follows actual synchronous file publication; the other asks for absent asynchronous GC context support under a separate narrow file scope. The absence task is not a negative variant of the file-publication task.
Embedded/imported OrderedMultiDict code is used only as a wrong alternative to the OneToOne task. No OMD clone is counted as a primary family.
Registration, wrapper initialization and warning-on-read are necessary stages within one source task, not separate families.

scope: Fixed source-only intra-draft semantic/component review; no retrieval or protected/unknown old-body reads.

semantic_signatures.f0001: Path component augmentation with compound-extension boundary selection.
semantic_signatures.f0002: Signed/fractional human duration parsing, its legacy alias, and recognized units.
semantic_signatures.f0003: Callable-backed delayed value conversion/rendering with cached results.
semantic_signatures.f0004: Mutation that reverses segmented storage without flattening it.
semantic_signatures.f0005: Bijective reassignment with old-owner eviction and live inverse synchronization.
semantic_signatures.f0006: Symmetric sorted dataset trimming and dependent-statistic cache invalidation.
semantic_signatures.f0007: JSON-line deserialization error skip-versus-propagate option and default.
semantic_signatures.f0008: Incoming netstring per-call size limits and bounded length-prefix reading.
semantic_signatures.f0009: Unix successful atomic-save completion and non-overwriting publication.
semantic_signatures.f0010: Module-member deprecation registration, namespace wrapper and warning-on-read.
semantic_signatures.f0011: Absence of asynchronous GC suspension context methods inside gcutils.py.
semantic_signatures.f0012: Absence of a Euclidean greatest-common-divisor implementation inside mathutils.py.
